CONDUCT OF GENERAL

(7TH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 31 OF 2002
An order further
to amend tire Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 19-10-2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub. dated
19-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Order may be called the Conduct of General
Elections (7th Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 19-10-2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub. dated
19-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
2. Insertion of new Article,
Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002.- In the Conduct of General Elections
Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 2002), after Article 8-E, the
following new Article shall be inserted, namely:---
"8-EE Nomination papers
for election.---Notwithstanding anything contained to any other law for the
time being in force, every nomination paper for the membership of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) and a Provincial Assembly, shall be delivered by
the candidate to person to the Returning Officer who shall acknowledge receipt
of the nomination paper specifying the date and time of receipt.,"
